title: Velocity Earning Credit Card - Bonus VFF Points (20,000 Referer /10,000 Referee) with Referral
body:
Deal: Velocity Earning Credit Card - Bonus VFF Points (20,000 Referer /10,000 Referee) with Referral

[Dunky] Can a Mod set up the referral system for this? :)
[Recollect9764] https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/139622#comment-17810013
[littlesoldier] When I create and click on my referral link, it only shows Westpac or Virgin Money credit card (I only currently / previously got Westpac Velocity and Virgin Money CC)
does it means that you can only refer the cards you have owned before?
[gembel] only can see Virgin Money and Westpac as well here
[puffinfresh] Unfortunately you're not eligible to generate a referral link.
[littlesoldier] Looks like you need to hold a Velocity point earning credit card to be able to create referral?
[knobbs] Logged into the wife's account with link VFF CC, still not eligible.
[rith] This is a targeted offer and is only available to Velocity members that have received this offer directly from Velocity Frequent Flyer via email. The Referrer offer is not transferrable.
Sad times.
[gembel] "meet the first year minimum spend criteria set out by your chosen card issuer"
what is the minimum spend criteria?
[Jetkuma] Careful of sharing your referral link. It actually include your real name in there.
[littlesoldier] seems is just to populate the website with the referrer name
changed to &referrerName=Donald+Trump and still works LOL
I believe only the referrerCode matters
[Dunky] I think you can delete the last bit, and the link will still work? website just displays friend instead
[Blokeinhisundies] When I generated my code there was a line to say the link will contain your first name.
Sure enough, my code just has my first name at the end.
[knight321] Got the email, waiting for mods to add referral system so I can add my link
[TightAryan] “Unfortunately you’re not eligible to generate referral link”
[xiaozaocha] my partner is holding a westpac va platium, could I be refered for westpac va black ?
[lawyerz] Ah BS, I just applied and just got approved last week
[gembel] Me too. Still worth it especially if you haven't met the min requirements yet. Usually their system is not that smart
[lawyerz] Card hasn't even arrived yet. Worth giving it a go, hoping for crappy systems on their part
[gembel] Same only digital card with my virgin money card. Physical card takes quite a while.
Used my wife's referral. Hoping for the 30k points
[KH234] Any way to track how many ppl signed in thr portal
